name: @opafex/privacy
description: PII redaction for logs and LLM payloads: same value, same token, so a redacted log is still debuggable. UK-aware, zero dependencies.

scripts.check:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m=>{if(typeof m.redactText!=='function')throw new Error('redactText missing');console.log('dist loads in plain Node')})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:dist
